## slingshot analysis [KC]

-   R 4.4.1

```{r}
library(Seurat)  # Seurat_4.4.0
# BiocManager::install("kstreet13/slingshot")
library(slingshot)

# BiocManager::install("DelayedMatrixStats")

set.seed(805181) ## for repeatability of cluster mapping.
```

### 1- prepare the slingshot input [based on Seurat]

```{r}
## input is seurat
load("R4_6.3_KC_only_processed.Rdata")
KC_only_processed-> selected_kc

#> Save the objects as separate matrices for input in slingshot
dimred <- selected_kc@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings # embedding
clustering <- selected_kc$cell_type_0.7 # the target anno
feature_genes<-selected_kc@assays$integrated@var.features # selected HVG
counts <- as.matrix(selected_kc@assays$RNA@counts[feature_genes, ]) # keep only HVG count matrix
```

### 2- lineage analysis

```{r}
# lineage analysis
set.seed(1)
lineages <- getLineages(data = dimred,
                        clusterLabels = clustering)
            ## start.clus = '1' , set start point
            ## end.clus = " ", set end point.

lineages@metadata$lineages-> path_kc
  # 4 paths

path_kc
```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-13%20at%2011.13.33%E2%80%AFPM.png)

### 3- Plot the lineages

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
pal <- c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1"), RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))
cluster_color[clustering]
# define the cluster colors
cluster_color= c(
"BAS-I"="#6BD76BCC",
"BAS-II"="#749B58CC"  ,
"BAS-III"="#CDDEB7CC",
"BAS-IV"="#466983CC" ,
"BAS-V"="#5DB1DDCC",
"SPN-I"= "#924822CC",
"SPN-II"= "#D58F5CCC",
"SPN-III"= "#E4AF69CC",
"SPN-IV"= "#F0E685CC" ,
"GRN-I"= "#AE1F63CC",
"GRN-II"= "#802268CC",
"GRN-III"= "#D595A7CC")

cluster_color[clustering]-> anno_clolor # define the color for cell_types

# Plot the lineages
pdf("R7_3_KC_umap_lineages_plot.pdf", width=6, height=6)
plot(dimred[, 1:2], 
     col = anno_clolor, 
     cex = 0.5, 
     pch = 16) +
lines(SlingshotDataSet(lineages), 
      lwd = 3, # line width
      col = "#4B3D34")
    ## show.constraints = TRUE
dev.off()
```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-14%20at%209.53.11%E2%80%AFAM.png){width="331"}

```{r}
## plot the anno umap.
pdf("R7_3_KC_umap_lineages_plot_anno.pdf", width=6, height=6)
plot(dimred[, 1:2], 
     col = anno_clolor, 
     cex = 0.5, 
     pch = 16)
for (i in levels(clustering)) {
    text(mean(dimred[clustering == i, 1]), mean(dimred[clustering == i, 2]), labels = i, font = 2)
}
dev.off()
```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-14%20at%209.58.53%E2%80%AFAM.png){width="336"}

```{r}
## make curve trajectories
crv_kc <- getCurves(lineages) ## make curve

pdf("R7_3_KC_umap_lineages_curve_plot.pdf", width=7, height=6)
plot(dimred[, 1:2],
     col = anno_clolor,
     cex = 0.5, 
     pch = 16)+
lines(SlingshotDataSet(crv_kc), lwd = 3, col = "#4B3D34")
dev.off()
```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-14%20at%2010.14.03%E2%80%AFAM.png){width="424"}

### 4- Pseudotime

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
# BiocManager::install('BiocStyle')
# devtools::install_github("davismcc/scater")
library(scater)
library(patchwork)

sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(selected_kc, assay = "RNA") # SCT

#> run slingshot
sce_slingshot <- slingshot(sce, #SingleCellExperiment object
                           reducedDim ='UMAP', # or PCA
                           clusterLabels=sce$cell_type_0.7) #celltype
                              #start.clus= '' # start point

#> Define the colors
    # colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11,'Spectral')[-6])(100)
colors = colorRampPalette(c("blue","green","yellow","orange","red"))(100)
```

#### 4.1-single path test

```{r}
library(fields) # scale bar
# BiocManager::install("fields")

#> plot_1 check
plotcol_1 <- colors[cut(sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_1, breaks=100)]

pdf("R7_4.1_KC_umap_pseudotime_1_plot.pdf", width=8, height=7)

# Set up layout: 1st panel for the plot, 2nd for the color bar
layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(5, 0.5))

# Adjust margins for the main plot
par(mar = c(5, 5, 2, 6))  # Bottom, left, top, right margins

plot(reducedDims(sce_slingshot)$UMAP,
     col=plotcol_1,
     pch=16,
     asp=1,
     cex=0.8)
# add trajectory lines
lines(SlingshotDataSet(lineages),
      lwd=2,
      col="#4B3D34") 
# Add color scale bar on the right
# Adjust margins for the color bar
par(mar = c(12, 1, 12, 4))  # Bottom, left, top, right margins

# Add color scale bar on the right
image.plot(legend.only = TRUE, 
           zlim = range(sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_1, na.rm = TRUE), 
           col = colors,
           legend.lab = "Pseudotime",
           legend.line = 2,
           legend.width = 1.2,  # Adjust the width of the color bar
           legend.cex = 0.8,    # Adjust font size of the legend
           cex.lab = 0.3,        # Adjust font size of the label (title)
           tcl = -0.3)   # Adjust tick length (negative values shorten ticks)

dev.off()

```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-14%20at%2010.48.28%E2%80%AFAM.png){width="354"}

```{r}
# plot color baar
color.bar <- function(lut, min, max=-min, nticks=5, 
                      ticks=seq(min, max, len=nticks), 
                      title='Pseudotime') {
    scale = (length(lut)-1)/(max-min)
    dev.new(width=1.75, height=5)
    plot(c(0,10), c(min,max), type='n', bty='n', xaxt='n', xlab='', yaxt='n', ylab='', main=title)
    axis(2, ticks, las=1)
    for (i in 1:(length(lut)-1)) {
     y = (i-1)/scale + min
     rect(0,y,10,y+1/scale, col=lut[i], border=NA)
    }
}

library(RColorBrewer)
colors = colorRampPalette(c("blue","green","yellow","orange","red"))(100)
color.bar(colors,0,100)

```

#### 4.2- batch for all paths

```{r}
## for loop for Pseudotime plot of paths
paths <- paste0("path_", 1:4) # if only 4 paths
pseudotime_list <- list(sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_1, 
                        sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_2, 
                        sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_3, 
                        sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_4)

pdf("R7_4_pseudotime_path_plot_umap.pdf", width=12, height=10)
par(mfrow = c(2,2), xpd=TRUE) #> c(nrow, ncol)

for(i in 1:length(pseudotime_list)){
plotcol <- colors[cut(pseudotime_list[[i]], breaks=100)]
plot(reducedDims(sce_slingshot)$UMAP,
     col=plotcol,
     pch=16,
     asp=1,
     cex=0.8,
     main = paths[i])+ # titles
lines(SlingshotDataSet(lineages),
      lwd=2,
      col="#4B3D34") }
dev.off()
```

![](images/Screenshot%202024-10-14%20at%209.51.14%E2%80%AFAM.png){width="482"}

### 5- save

```{r}
lineages-> kc_lineages
sce_slingshot -> kc_sce_slingshot 

save(kc_lineages, kc_sce_slingshot,file = "R7_5_slingshot_kc_obj.Rdata")
```

### 2- FibHSE [SPN free]

```{r}
##> input is seurat list
load("R6_5_seurat_KC_list.Rdata")

kc_list$FibHSE -> selected_obj

## remove SPN-I, SPN-II, SPN-III, SPN-IV.from FibHSE
# Subset cells that are NOT in the specified cell types
selected_id <- selected_obj@meta.data[!(selected_obj@meta.data$cell_type_0.7 %in% c("SPN-I", "SPN-II", "SPN-III", "SPN-IV")), ] # 1803 cells
#> extract only selected cells
new_selected_obj <- subset(selected_obj, cells=row.names(selected_id))

#new obj
new_selected_obj-> selected_obj

#> Save the objects as separate matrices for input in slingshot
dimred <- selected_obj@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings # embedding
clustering <- selected_obj$cell_type_0.7 # the target anno
feature_genes<-selected_obj@assays$integrated@var.features # selected HVG
counts <- as.matrix(selected_obj@assays$RNA@counts[feature_genes, ]) # keep only HVG count matrix
```

```{r}
#> lineage analysis
set.seed(1)
lineages <- getLineages(data = dimred,
                        clusterLabels = clustering)
            ## start.clus = '1' , set start point
            ## end.clus = " ", set end point.

lineages@metadata$lineages-> path_kc
  # 5 paths

path_kc
```

### 3- PmtHEE [BAS-I/II/III/IV free]

```{r}
##> input is seurat list
load("R6_5_seurat_KC_list.Rdata")

kc_list$PmtHEE -> selected_obj

## remove SPN-I, SPN-II, SPN-III, SPN-IV.from FibHSE
# Subset cells that are NOT in the specified cell types
selected_id <- selected_obj@meta.data[!(selected_obj@meta.data$cell_type_0.7 %in% c("BAS-I", "BAS-II", "BAS-III", "BAS-IV")), ] # 4109 cells
#> extract only selected cells
new_selected_obj <- subset(selected_obj, cells=row.names(selected_id))

#new obj
new_selected_obj-> selected_obj

#> Save the objects as separate matrices for input in slingshot
dimred <- selected_obj@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings # embedding
clustering <- selected_obj$cell_type_0.7 # the target anno
feature_genes<-selected_obj@assays$integrated@var.features # selected HVG
counts <- as.matrix(selected_obj@assays$RNA@counts[feature_genes, ]) # keep only HVG count matrix
```

```{r}
#> lineage analysis
set.seed(1)
lineages <- getLineages(data = dimred,
                        clusterLabels = clustering,
                        start.clus = 'BAS-V')
            ## start.clus = '1' , set start point
            ## end.clus = " ", set end point.

lineages@metadata$lineages-> path_kc
  # 5 paths

path_kc
```

```{r}
#> 4- Pseudotime
library(SingleCellExperiment)

library(scater)
library(patchwork)

sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(selected_obj, assay = "RNA") # SCT

#> run slingshot
sce_slingshot <- slingshot(sce, #SingleCellExperiment object
                           reducedDim ='UMAP', # or PCA
                           clusterLabels=sce$cell_type_0.7) #celltype
                              #start.clus= '' # start point

#> Define the colors
    # colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11,'Spectral')[-6])(100)

```

```{r}
##> 4.1-single path test
library(fields) # scale bar
# BiocManager::install("fields")

#> plot_1 check
plotcol_1 <- colors[cut(sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_1, breaks=100)]

pdf("R7_PmtHEE_4.1_umap_pseudotime_1_plot.pdf", width=8, height=7)

# Set up layout: 1st panel for the plot, 2nd for the color bar
layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(5, 0.5))

# Adjust margins for the main plot
par(mar = c(5, 5, 2, 6))  # Bottom, left, top, right margins

plot(reducedDims(sce_slingshot)$UMAP,
     col=plotcol_1,
     pch=16,
     asp=1,
     cex=0.8)
# add trajectory lines
lines(SlingshotDataSet(lineages),
      lwd=2,
      col="#4B3D34") 
# Add color scale bar on the right
# Adjust margins for the color bar
par(mar = c(12, 1, 12, 4))  # Bottom, left, top, right margins

# Add color scale bar on the right
image.plot(legend.only = TRUE, 
           zlim = range(sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_1, na.rm = TRUE), 
           col = colors,
           legend.lab = "Pseudotime",
           legend.line = 2,
           legend.width = 1.2,  # Adjust the width of the color bar
           legend.cex = 0.8,    # Adjust font size of the legend
           cex.lab = 0.3,        # Adjust font size of the label (title)
           tcl = -0.3)   # Adjust tick length (negative values shorten ticks)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# plot color baar only, if need.
color.bar <- function(lut, min, max=-min, nticks=5, 
                      ticks=seq(min, max, len=nticks), 
                      title='Pseudotime') {
    scale = (length(lut)-1)/(max-min)
    dev.new(width=1.75, height=5)
    plot(c(0,10), c(min,max), type='n', bty='n', xaxt='n', xlab='', yaxt='n', ylab='', main=title)
    axis(2, ticks, las=1)
    for (i in 1:(length(lut)-1)) {
     y = (i-1)/scale + min
     rect(0,y,10,y+1/scale, col=lut[i], border=NA)
    }
}

library(RColorBrewer)
colors = colorRampPalette(c("blue","green","yellow","orange","red"))(100)
color.bar(colors,0,100)
```

```{r}
##> 4.2- batch for all paths

                        sce_slingshot$slingPseudotime_2)

par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE) #> c(nrow, ncol)

for(i in 1:length(pseudotime_list)){
plotcol <- colors[cut(pseudotime_list[[i]], breaks=100)]
plot(reducedDims(sce_slingshot)$UMAP,
     col=plotcol,
     pch=16,
     asp=1,
     cex=0.8,
     main = paths[i])+ # titles
lines(SlingshotDataSet(lineages),
      lwd=2,
      col="#4B3D34") }
dev.off()
```
